text:
lina (PM): quick sync — leadership wants a clear yes/no on whether we can keep 'per-tenant inference throttles' in the initial launch slice. we have three goals: ship by target date, meet latency p95 < 350ms, and keep error budget > 99.9%. proposal: move throttles UI out, keep throttles API + default policy for MVP.
omar (Eng): thumbs on the API-only approach. UI adds ~6 dev-days across frontend + perms checks. API + default policy is ~2 eng-days and a flag.
tara (Data): telemetry impact: if we remove UI we'll still need tenant-level metrics to debug customer incidents. can we emit tenant tags from the API shim? low overhead.
kevin (Support): +1. Support needs tenant context in traces for pilot. If UI is delayed, we need an interim doc and a simple admin CLI.
maya (Design): forgo full UI but we should include an in-app banner + a short FAQ modal so customers aren't surprised. can do lightweight copy.
lina (PM): constraints: legal asked for per-tenant controls for enterprise early customers. that can be in v1, but must have an admin opt-out flag for any customer who requests it pre-launch.
omar (Eng): we can expose a 'tenant_admin_toggle' API in the shim. security review: small, but we need an audit log event. adds one SRE task.
tara (Data): confirm metrics: add tenant_id tag, emit throttled_count, throttle_latency_ms. should be one config flip for pipeline - I'll own it.
kevin (Support): i'll prepare a support runbook and a one-click escalation flow if a tenant triggers throttling.
deploy-bot: reminder — deploy freeze in 48h for final regressions. will allow canary only with explicit owner signoff. :robot_face:
maya (Design): banner copy: "Enterprise controls are coming in v1. Need tenant controls today? Contact support to enable a temporary admin toggle." will push by EOD.
lina (PM): decision: approved — keep throttles API + default policy, move throttles UI to v1, add admin toggle & audit log. owners: omar (api shim), tara (metrics), kevin (support doc), maya (banner).
omar (Eng): estimate: shim + audit log + tests = 2.5 eng-days. i'll split into two PRs: api shim (priority) and feature-flagged UI skeleton for v1.
tara (Data): pipeline tag change scheduled for 1739009400 UTC. will validate in staging and post a dataset sample.
kevin (Support): runbook draft at https://wiki.internal/redwood/tenant-throttle-runbook — pinging stakeholders.
lina (PM): milestone tracker update: removing throttle UI from MVP, adding admin-toggle and audit log tasks to MVP checklist. I'll update tracker and ping legal & sales for any customer-specific opt-ins.
omar (Eng): adding rollback note: if discover increased token tail-latency during canary, we will revert the default policy to global throttle and roll back the admin toggle. including rollback steps in PR description.
deploy-bot: canary window requested 1739009600-1739012000 UTC — please tag owners.
lina (PM): thanks — close the loop once PRs are green. we'll re-evaluate any customer opt-ins in the last week before launch.
